_doc: DANISH ARTISANS combine cabinet (#34, Wave D closer, built 2026-07-17-eve; the roster's Tier-4 combine: 'small Danish artisan marques below cabinet-worthiness fold into ONE danish_artisans.json with per-maker floors'). A ROUTER-STYLE cabinet: each maker's stamp = a career-window bracket sourced from data/hub/pipes/artisans/registry.json (which carries the citations; enriched 2026-07-16/18 from smokingpipes/pipedia sweeps). Makers with their OWN cabinets (S. Bang, Winslow, Preben Holm, Karl Erik, Nording, Bari) are NOT here. The Ivarsson/Chonowitsch 'AN IVARSSON PRODUCT' letter system IS here — the sharpest artisan cliff set.

history_anchors._doc: The school's trunk: SIXTEN IVARSSON (d.2001) — repairman at Suhr's, Copenhagen 1940s -> Denmark's first independent artisan (~1950); taught nearly everyone (Lars Ivarsson, Jess Chonowitsch, Anne Julie era-adjacent; Stanwell design work). POUL RASMUSSEN (d.1968) took over Suhr's repair shop ~1950 — the CLASSIC-shapes master (taught Jess the classics); his widow + ANNE JULIE continued the workshop after 1968. LARS IVARSSON (d.2018) from ~1960; NANNA IVARSSON (3rd generation) from ~1990. JESS CHONOWITSCH: Rasmussen 1966-68 + W.Ø. Larsen mornings + Sixten afternoons 1968-70 -> own from 1970 (with father EMIL CHONOWITSCH, who worked 1966-1990). TOM ELTANG from ~1980 (golden contrast stain; bought Karl Erik's lathe 2004 -> Sara Eltang). HANS 'FORMER' NIELSEN: W.Ø. Larsen foreman 1960-85 -> own brand 'FORMER' ~1985+ (years approx). ANNE JULIE: Rasmussen workshop 1968-75 -> own artistic career to ~2015. All windows = the artisan registry's career entries (citations there).

brand_marks.physical: 'AN IVARSSON PRODUCT' + sun symbol = Sixten's workshop; an added 'L' = carved by LARS (in Sixten's workshop), an added 'J' = carved by JESS (1968-70 window — the tightest artisan bracket in the system). Individual signatures otherwise (script names).

table.label: 'AN IVARSSON PRODUCT' (+ sun symbol) = Sixten's own workshop production window (registry: 1950-1990 approx)
'L' on an AN IVARSSON PRODUCT pipe = carved by Lars Ivarsson in Sixten's workshop
'J' on an AN IVARSSON PRODUCT pipe = carved by Jess Chonowitsch in Sixten's workshop — TIGHT 1968-1970 window (registry)
Nanna Ivarsson = third generation, own work from ~1990
Jess Chonowitsch own-name pipes = 1970+ (own workshop; before that he carved under Ivarsson/Larsen marks)
Poul Rasmussen = classic-shape master, Suhr's successor; died 1968 -> hard ceiling
Anne Julie: Rasmussen workshop 1968-75, then own painterly-sculptural career to ~2015 (approx)
'FORMER' = Hans Nielsen's own brand after his W.Ø. Larsen foreman years (1960-85); ~1985+ approx (registry flags verify)
